name: Beat the Same Drum / four live actual controlled-token conditions
notes: With legal young Warrior Dorinthea, first actually play already-qualified physical GobletOfBloodrunWineBlue5 from Hand at printed0, spending oneAP. All four living seats manually respond; only the fourth response creates owned Agility7 and Vigor8, moves Goblet5 to own publicGraveyard FaceDown0 and returns printed go-again AP1. This is real token creation during this same turn, so controlled-Agility and controlled-Vigor conditions are true without any seeded history flag. Actually play primary BeatTheSameDrumBlue6 from Hand at printed0, spending that AP. All four real seats manually respond while exactly original Agility7/Vigor8 remain; no extra token before the fourth pass. The fourth creates exactly one additional Agility9 and one additional Vigor10, then source6 ends own publicGraveyard FaceDown0 after Goblet5 and printed go again returns AP1. Final Arena order is Agility7,Vigor8,Agility9,Vigor10, all Owner1/Controller1/Status2. No Confidence, Might or Toughness was controlled or created. All health20/resources0, Hand empty and all queues/other zones empty. Only positive repeat-creation for two types whose control was established by actual preceding Goblet play. Controlled-but-no-longer-present, Confidence/Might/Toughness positive conditions, multiple earlier copies, start-turn destruction/benefits, replacement, expiry and Dorinthea ability remain untested. Existing Goblet support is not new primary coverage. No fabricated played/control counters or direct post-recording creation.
